tool_args.rationale: The pilot only reaches H=0.48, while the target horizon is 20.3. The slow-horizon probe directly tests and calibrates the suspected endogenous adaptation and reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon pilot rows do not identify the slow adaptation needed to forecast at H=20.3.
More fine-resolution short-horizon observations would be less directly informative about the slow reversal.
It does not resolve the forecast-horizon ambiguity.
